name: cortex
description: Durable tasks, advisory governance and immutable Markdown reports for model-owned coordination.

interface.longDescription: Cortex 1.15.8 provides seven storage tools and 23 specialist profiles, including an opt-in report-only senior consultant. The server creates typed, thread-bound Markdown drafts; the coordinator manages one pipeline with newest editions first and native subagents. Reports are real project files and SQLite indexes brief metadata. The model interprets evidence and handles steering.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with a durable Markdown pipeline and appropriate specialist subagents.
